name: @aecstudio/kchat-extension
description: KChat Desktop (.kcz) extension that bridges AEC Studio's publish queue and review-comment ingestion through the AEC Studio loopback HTTP API.
//peerDependencies: React is injected by the KChat Desktop extension host at activation time (the .kcz model — every extension shares the host's React instance to avoid the two-React-instances hooks bug when contributing views to slots). The peer declaration makes that contract explicit: npm/pnpm/yarn warn if the host doesn't satisfy it, TypeScript and editor tooling find a real module to type-check against, and a future contributor cannot accidentally migrate React into `dependencies` (which would bundle a duplicate copy into the .kcz).
